doc.title: Kent Jordan interviewed by Monk Rowe, Rome, New York, August 22, 2006

title: Flautist or flutist
summary: Jordan quotes James Galway on the term; Rowe compares it to violin versus fiddle.

story.theme_name: How I got my name: nicknames and band monikers
story.community_name: How I got my name: nicknames and band names

blocks.x: Do you think of yourself as a flautist or a flutist?
Well you know you get that question a lot. I think James Galway answered that question for everybody, you know you’re just a flutist and every once in a while you might flaut.
Okay, that’s good. It’s like the difference between a violin and a fiddle player.
Right. A violin and a fiddle player. You know most violinists call themselves fiddle players, so yeah that’s an interesting dichotomy there.
